caption:
A job seeker tried to trick an AI interview bot by claiming they were hallucinating.

The bot took the statement literally, spitting out garbled answers that left everyone baffled 🤖.

This weird glitch shows why we need smarter safeguards for AI hiring tools. What would you do if a bot went haywire in an interview?
